subject: Sage Systems: privacy gate - vendor intake & PO path
messages:
From: Tom Hsu <t.hsu@sagesystems.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@sagesystems.com
Date: 2028-10-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Supplier privacy gate - vendor intake & PO path

Hi Naomi,

We're starting the supplier intake for Redwood as part of our October vendor panel. Security asks that we get the following before we can progress to PO:
- Signed DPA or DocuSign-ready DPA
- SOC 2 report or a link to the hosted report and an ACL for reviewers
- Current subprocessor list (CSV preferred)
- Vendor contact for invoicing + standard PO routing instructions

Do you have a DPA and a public SOC 2 link you can send? Our target is to have the PO issued by 2028-11-10, so it'd be great to get files this week.

Also, can you put an expected billing cadence (monthly/annual) and the billing email in your reply so our AP team can open the PO?

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Hsu
Sage Systems — Procurement
procurement@sagesystems.com

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v2.pdf (attached), Redwood_subprocessors_2028-10.csv (attached)

SOC 2: public report (read-only) is hosted here: https://redwoodinference.app/soc2/report-2028
DocuSign DPA (if you want to sign electronically): https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC-123-REDWOOD

Billing details for PO:
- Payee name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Billing email: accounts-payable@redwoodinference.com
- Remit address: 123 Market St, Suite 500, San Francisco, CA 94105
- Typical billing cadence: monthly invoicing; invoices are net 30 by default

Ben (cc'd) is the AM on this account — he can confirm the onboarding fees and any SOW references you should include on the PO. Laura, looping you in for any legal flags on the DPA we attached.

If your security team needs an evidence handoff (eg, principle of least privilege, data retention specifics), we can provide an evidence bundle and set up a short call with one of our platform engineers. Please share a few windows for the call.

Thanks,

Tom — quick note on the PO path and SOW references so AP matches it correctly: 

PO routing: please send the official PO PDF to accounts-payable@redwoodinference.com and cc legal@redwoodinference.com if there are special contract notes. 

SOW / reference: include "SOW-REDWOOD-2028-09" in the reference line for onboarding services. That ensures our billing attaches the initial onboarding fee to the right project.

Estimated onboarding fee: one-time setup fee of $6,000 + first month usage. Ongoing usage is billed monthly. If your AP needs a vendor number, we are US-V-34921.

If you prefer we can accept a PO with a pending DPA (signed within the next 14 days) — however we typically require an executed DPA before production traffic. Happy to be flexible to meet your procurement timeline.

For the security evidence review, Naomi, I'd prioritize a 30–45 minute call with L3 platform engineer and your security reviewer. Tom, what times work for your team next week (Nov 6–8)?

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

- Tue 2028-11-07 09:00-11:00 PT
- Wed 2028-11-08 13:00-15:00 PT

If those work, share a calendar invite and we'll get the review scheduled.
